name: Gakuen Club Triangle ~Seifuku to Shojo to Amai Kaori~
original_name: 学園クラブトライアングル～制服と処女と甘い香り～
source:
Jin is a head of a detective group and solves various problems asked by female students every day. Like this, he becomes close with a lot of pretty girls, but they never allow him to have an affair with other girls.... Well, will he be able to live a happy school life without being detected...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081108111117/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011706]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
金是侦探团的组长，每天解决女学生提出的各种问题。就这样，他和很多漂亮女孩变得亲密起来，但她们却不允许他和其他女孩有染……那么，他能在不被发现的情况下过上幸福的学校生活吗……？

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081108111117/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011706]ErogeShop[/url]]
